question: Should OpenClaw add a default-off WebChat-to-last-external mirroring config, fold this behavior into the broader origin-delivery policy, or keep Control UI delivery explicit-only?
rationale: The code path is clear, but the behavior intentionally crosses channel and privacy boundaries and overlaps a broader origin-delivery design issue.

options.title: Decide under origin-delivery policy
options.body: Use this issue as the narrow WebChat mirroring requirement while defining the shared route freshness, authorization, and duplicate-delivery rules alongside the broader origin-delivery work.

options.title: Ship a narrow default-off mirror flag
options.body: Add the requested session config only if maintainers accept a separate WebChat mirroring policy and require live Discord or Telegram proof before merge.

options.title: Keep explicit delivery only
options.body: Close or defer the feature if maintainers decide WebChat should never reuse stored external routes without an explicit per-message deliver route.

recommendation.title: Decide under origin-delivery policy
recommendation.body: Use this issue as the narrow WebChat mirroring requirement while defining the shared route freshness, authorization, and duplicate-delivery rules alongside the broader origin-delivery work.
